notes: Activity is now a permission you can grant or withhold. It shipped with none - any signed-in account could see the whole timeline, including exactly when the house stood empty and who came and went. It now has its own chip in Admin, and the tile, page and dashboard card all vanish without it. Roxann keeps it: permissions added after accounts already exist are granted once to everyone who already had a login, so nobody loses a page they had yesterday - and if you then untick it, it stays unticked. The permission labels also now say what they actually grant: Chores reads 'Chores, Points, Departures & Allowance payouts', because since 1.32.0 it authorises handing over money. A note on the Admin page lists what no chip can delegate: the Admin page itself, Stack Health, applying updates and the sign-in log.
